newsitem.title: MEXICO: Thousands evacuated from Mexican zoo after power cut.
newsitem.headline: Thousands evacuated from Mexican zoo after power cut.

text.p: More than 16,000 visitors were evacuated from Mexico City's Chapultepec zoo park Saturday after a double power failure forced emergency measures, authorities said on Sunday.
The zoo's animals, including big cats and bears, are controlled behind electric fences not unlike those featured in the blockbuster Hollywood movie Jurassic Park.
Zoo director Maria Elena Hoyo said one high voltage underground cable faulted in mid-afternoon causing the power cut and a battery-powered back-up system failed to kick into action.

Hoyo played down the evacuation, saying there was little danger because the animals were still behind fences, dry ditches and moats. She said the underground cable was fixed overnight and the zoo would be open Sunday as normal.
